hosted_gate_follow_up.change: Split tests into budget, evaluation, compaction and provider modules.

question_completeness.behavior: Full list and complete list requests settle their accepted pending batch despite a false narrow evaluator flag; narrow and general answers may still finish early.

capture_termination.behavior: Observe source termination before playback, reject ended/stale startup, and preserve replacement capture during reentrant owner callbacks.

stopped_activity.behavior: Keep meaningful image activity through abort and render activity-only stopped messages without a running spinner; empty ordinary assistants remain hidden.

draft_cancellation.behavior: Preserve newer and deliberately cleared drafts; recover untouched browser/ordinary prompts and the first cancelled ordinary prompt for a multi-turn queue.
